periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Held three community talks on recovery options in Harbor Creek and North Inlet and started a social media series on local treatment. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add a talk for seaport workers and plan a recovery month event series.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Held four talks, including one at the Seaport Workers Clinic, and planned a recovery month series with partners. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Seaport Workers Clinic, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run the recovery month series with five talks, including one at the seaport hiring hall.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Held a recovery month event series with five community talks, including one at the seaport hiring hall. Social media posts about local treatment options reached about 24,000 residents. Partners: Coastal Behavioral Health, Seaport Workers Clinic, faith partners.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Plan Spanish-language sessions in Old Ferry Road and share family stories from people in recovery.
